testCase:
D-08: Preset ranges and a custom one
Goal: Set the report range from 5 October to 18 October 2026.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-08/
STEP 2: Click "Custom"
STEP 3: Click "Previous month"
STEP 4: Click "5 October 2026" and then "18 October 2026"
STEP 5: Click "Apply"
STEP 6: Verify "Report range: 5 October 2026 to 18 October 2026" is visible

steps.note: Open the report range test page.
Verify the report shows the exact requested range.

reasoning: This test checks that applying a custom date range updates the report to 5–18 October 2026. The plan follows the specified calendar interactions and asserts the exact report range text.
